subject: 📝 Your health appointment has been updated (Ref #$appointment_id)
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your appointment with the University Health Centre has been updated by $updated_by. The changes are listed below so you can see exactly what is different.

=== WHAT CHANGED ===
$change_list

=== YOUR APPOINTMENT AS IT STANDS NOW ===
Reference Number: $appointment_id
Type: $appointment_type
Date: $appointment_date
Time: $appointment_time
Provider: $provider
Status: $status

Reason:
$reason

Notes:
$notes

Updated On: $updated_at

=== DO YOU NEED TO DO ANYTHING? ===
If the date, time or provider changed, check the new details still work for you and tell us as soon as possible if they do not. If only the reason or notes changed, no action is needed.

=== BEFORE YOU COME ===
Arrive 15 minutes early, bring your student ID, and let us know on arrival if your symptoms have changed.

=== IF THIS IS NOT RIGHT ===
If you did not expect these changes, contact the Health Centre quoting reference $appointment_id. Any change can be reversed.

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Health Centre: health@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Best regards,
University Health Centre

$signature
